description: Find EV charging stations where you can charge and pay with the Elton app near an address (Norway, looked up in Kartverket's address register) or a point (lat and lng, any of the three countries), nearest first, with how far each is in a straight line. Each comes with its address, coordinates, most powerful charger, the places to eat and food shops within a short walk, and a link to its page. Each station's appUrl opens it in the Elton app. Never prices.

address.description: An address in Norway, as "Gladengveien 2, Oslo", or a place name, as "Rauland".

country.description: The country whose roads and stations to use: no (Norway), se (Sweden), dk (Denmark).

food.description: Only stations with this place to eat or food shop nearby, by name, chain or cuisine, as "Burger King", "Rema 1000" or "pizza".

lat.description: Latitude of the point to search round (WGS84), with lng instead of an address.

limit.description: At most this many stations: 10 if not given, 50 at most.

lng.description: Longitude of the point to search round (WGS84).

minKw.description: Only stations with a charger of at least this many kW.

radiusKm.description: How far round, in km in a straight line: 5 if not given, 50 at most.

withFood.description: Only stations with a place to eat or a food shop nearby.

name: find_stations_near
title: Find charging stations nearby
